response.sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM order_counts), above_average AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count, oa.avg_order_count FROM order_counts AS oc CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_order_count), above_average_mean AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_above_order_count FROM above_average) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.order_count, aa.order_count - aa.avg_order_count AS above_overall_average, aa.order_count - aam.avg_above_order_count AS above_above_average FROM above_average AS aa CROSS JOIN above_average_mean AS aam ORDER BY above_above_average DESC, aa.account_id LIMIT 10;
